profile.name: Cobolt 06-01系列激光器
profile.description: Cobolt 06-01系列是一类实验室激光器，可提供稳定激光输出，并支持恒功率、恒电流及数字/模拟调制控制。该类设备常用于光学实验、激发光源、光路对准和各类测量场景。
profile.description_en: The Cobolt 06-01 Series is a family of laboratory lasers that provides stable laser output and supports constant-power, constant-current, and digital/analog modulation control. These devices are commonly used for optical experiments, excitation, beam alignment, and measurement applications.
